services.name: Stand-Up Paddle boards – 1-7 Day Rentals
services.desc: Starting at $55 About Aussie Watersports rents out Riviera stand-up paddle boards (SUPs) in Northern Michigan with free delivery to the greater Traverse City area. Whether you’re looking for a fun way to enjoy the Grand Traverse Bay with the kids or you want to check out one of our many lakes, SUPs are easy to transport and the perfect toy for a summer day.
